title: Bake the Sum
prompt: Implement `tableSum` so the test computes it at compile time inside a lambda and static_asserts the result.

tests.name: compile-time sum bakes
tests.hint: constexpr int tableSum(const int* a, std::size_t n) { int s = 0; for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) s += a[i]; return s; } — loops are fine in constexpr.

tests.name: runtime use still works
tests.hint: Same function serves runtime arrays — constexpr is a capability, not a restriction.
